---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The AEO outcome you want

What are you trying to achieve? Examples:

- More citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or AI Overviews
- Better schema coverage for a specific content type
- More control over which AI crawlers can access which content
- Clearer visibility into how AI engines are seeing your site
- Better integration with another plugin or platform

## What you do today

How are you currently working around this? (Manual edits, another plugin, custom code, just not doing it.)

## What you would like to see in AEO God Mode

Describe the feature as you would expect to use it. UI, settings, output, behaviour.

## Why this matters

Who benefits, and how often does the situation come up.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you have thought about, and why this one is preferred.

## Additional context

Screenshots, links to similar features in other tools, anything else useful.
